units.source_text: 在节日甚多的京都，千重子喜欢鞍马寺的火节胜过“大字”。

en.t: In Kyoto, where there are so many festivals, Chieko liked the Kurama Temple Fire Festival more than the Daimonji bonfire.

units.source_text: 由于地点不太远，苗子也去看过。

en.t: Since the place was not very far away, Naeko had gone to see it too.

units.source_text: 但是，以往即使在火节的活动场地擦肩而过，她们俩彼此也不会留意。

en.t: But in the past, even if the two of them had brushed past each other at the fire festival grounds, neither would have noticed the other.
